    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">学习理论：凸代理与在线学习regret界证明</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1784958/202607/1784958-20260718140517033-1699514846.png" alt="学习理论：凸代理与在线学习regret界证明" class="desc_img">
        科研方面我近期在进行读博第二份工作的证明工作。这篇博客旨在以论文《Exploiting the surrogate gap in online multiclass classification》为主要参考，介绍凸代理技术是如何运用于在线学习的regret界证明中的，整体而言偏向公式细节推导。凸代理可以为在线学习中regret界的证明提供有力的工具。不仅仅是由于引入了凸代理后可以直接应用在线梯度下降（online gradient descent, OGD）等在线凸优化算法在凸假设下获得至少为的regret界保障，而且若能充分利用代理损失函数的特性，比如强凸、对数凹（exp-concavity）、混合能力（mixability），则可进一步获得O}(ln T)甚至更好的regret界保证。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">

</center>
<p>科研方面我近期在进行读博第二份工作的证明工作。这篇博客旨在以论文《Exploiting the surrogate gap in online multiclass classification》<sup>[1]</sup>为主要参考，介绍凸代理技术是如何运用于在线学习的regret界证明中的，整体而言偏向公式细节推导。</p>
<h1 id="1-导引">1 导引</h1>
<p>凸代理可以为在线学习中regret界的证明提供有力的工具。不仅仅是由于引入了凸代理后可以直接应用在线梯度下降（online gradient descent, OGD）<sup>[2]</sup>等在线凸优化算法在凸假设下获得至少为<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})\)</span>的regret界保障，而且若能充分利用代理损失函数的特性<sup>[1]</sup>，比如强凸、对数凹（exp-concavity）<sup>[3]</sup>、混合能力（mixability）<sup>[4]</sup>，则可进一步获得<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}(\ln T)\)</span>甚至更好的regret界保证。论文《Exploiting the surrogate gap in online multiclass classification》<sup>[1][5]</sup>就较好地展现了凸代理在在线学习regret界证明中的应用。论文作者证明，在充分利用代理损失函数与目标函数间的差距的情况下，在完全信息（full information）的设置下甚至可以达到常数阶的regret界。</p>
<h1 id="2-利用代理与目标函数间的差距">2 利用代理与目标函数间的差距</h1>
<p>考虑在线多分类场景，该场景可能是<strong>完全信息（full information）</strong>的或<strong>bandit</strong>的（完全信息和bandit场景的区别可参见我之前的博客<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/orion-orion/p/20086331" target="_blank">《学习理论：在线弃权学习》</a>）<sup>[6]</sup>。设学习过程包括<span class="math inline">\(T\)</span>轮迭代，每轮迭代<span class="math inline">\(t\)</span>时环境会暴露特征向量<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{x}_t\in \mathbb{R}^d\)</span>给学习器（假设其对所有<span class="math inline">\(T\)</span>都满足有界条件<span class="math inline">\(\lVert\boldsymbol{x}_t\rVert\leqslant X\)</span>）。学习器基于<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{x}_t\)</span>返回一个（随机化的）预测值<span class="math inline">\(y^{\prime}_t\in \mathcal{Y} = \{1,\cdots, K\}\)</span>。在完全信息设置下，在学习器做出预测后，环境会暴露真实标签<span class="math inline">\(y_t\in \mathcal{Y} = \{1,\cdots, K\}\)</span>给学习器；而在bandit设置下，环境只会返回学习器是否预测正确，也即<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t]\)</span>。该论文只考虑对抗设置，也即意味着不对<span class="math inline">\(y_t\)</span>或<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{x}_t\)</span>如何生成的做出假设。在完全信息和bandit两种设置中，论文都允许学习器使用随机化预测。对于bandit设置而言，使用随机化预测可以达到<strong>探索（explore）</strong> 的作用。这两种设置下的目标都是去控制学习器在<span class="math inline">\(T\)</span>轮迭代中的期望错误数</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    M_T = \mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t]\right]
\]</div><p></p><p>其中期望部分随机性的来源是关于学习器的随机性。</p>
<p>而对于这两种设置而言，标准实践都是用一个凸代理损失函数<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t\)</span>去做为非凸的0-1损失的上界。设这里的凸代理损失<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t\)</span>是关于<span class="math inline">\(K\times d\)</span>的权重矩阵<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{W}_t\in \mathcal{W}\)</span>的线性函数，其中<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{W} = \left\{\boldsymbol{W}: \lVert \boldsymbol{W} \rVert\leqslant D\right\}\)</span>。其中<span class="math inline">\(\lVert\boldsymbol{W}\rVert\)</span>表示矩阵的Frobenius范数。</p>
<p>则在<span class="math inline">\(T\)</span>轮迭代后的regret可以表示为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \mathcal{R}_T = \mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(\boldsymbol{U})\right]
\]</div><p></p><p>其中<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{I}\)</span>是示性函数。</p>
<p>为了优化该regret，可以将其做进一步分解：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \begin{aligned}
        &amp;\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t]\right] - \mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(\boldsymbol{U})\right]\\
        &amp;= \mathbb{E}\left[\underbrace{\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)}_{\leqslant 0} + \sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{U})\right]\\
    \end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>是<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t]\)</span>的凸上界可知项<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>是负的。一种直截的处理方式是直接将这一项放缩掉，即得到</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \mathcal{R}_T \leqslant \sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{U})
\]</div><p></p><p>然后在使用OGD算法的条件下采用标准的在线凸优化证明技术<sup>[1][7]</sup>得到</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{U}) \leqslant \frac{\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{2\eta} + \sum_{t=1}^T\frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2
\]</div><p></p><p>这里<span class="math inline">\(\eta\)</span>是学习率。假设<span class="math inline">\(f_t\)</span>对所有<span class="math inline">\(t\)</span>是<span class="math inline">\(\phi\)</span>-Liptchitz的（意味着梯度满足有界条件<span class="math inline">\(\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert\leqslant \rho\)</span>）并假设<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{W}\)</span>是<span class="math inline">\(D\)</span>-有界的，取<span class="math inline">\(\eta = \frac{D}{\rho\sqrt{T}}\)</span>，可以进一步得到：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{U}) \leqslant D\rho\sqrt{T}
\]</div><p></p><p>这是一个<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})\)</span>的regret界。观察可知这里的<span class="math inline">\(\sqrt{T}\)</span>项主要来自于随着<span class="math inline">\(t\)</span>的增长项<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{t=1}^T\frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\)</span>，而另一项<span class="math inline">\(\frac{\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{2\eta}\)</span>本身是不随着迭代步数<span class="math inline">\(T\)</span>增长的常数项。</p>
<p>根据论文《Exploiting the surrogate gap in online multiclass classification》<sup>[1][5]</sup>作者的发现，regret分解产生的<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>这一项有充分的利用价值而在某些情况下不应该直接被放缩掉。相反，在某些情况下这一项将会负得足够多甚至甚至可以将增长项<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{t=1}^T\frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\)</span>给抵消掉。</p>
<p>若保留这一项，则可得到如下所示的regret界：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \begin{aligned}
        \mathcal{R}_T &amp;= \mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \underbrace{\sum_{t=1}^T\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{U})}_{\text{bounded via OGD}}\right]\\
        &amp;\leqslant \frac{\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{2\eta} + \underbrace{\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]}_{\mathcal{M}}
    \end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中记项<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \sum_{t=1}^T\frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\)</span>为<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{M}\)</span>。若能证明<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{M}\)</span>在特定设置下（比如完全信息的设置下） <span class="math inline">\(\leqslant 0\)</span>则可达成常数阶的regret界。由于论文利用<span class="math inline">\(\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>这一差距（gap）的特点，本文作者将该方法称为GAPTRON。</p>
<h1 id="3-验证代理差距是否可">3 验证代理差距是否可<span class="math inline">\(\leqslant 0\)</span></h1>
<p>接下来介绍如何去界定</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \mathcal{M} = \mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]
\]</div><p></p><p>我们先来看论文算法每轮迭代预测的标签值<span class="math inline">\(y^{\prime}_t\)</span>是如何产生的。如果考虑完全信息的设置且不引入随机性的话，那么一个合理的选择是使得模型输出score最大的标签：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[y^*_t = \mathrm{arg \space max}_k\langle \boldsymbol{W}_t^k, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle
\]</div><p></p><p>但论文的方法不只考虑了完全信息的设置，还考虑了bandit的设置。本文的算法在每一轮的预测中引入了随机性，而这可以在bandit设置中达到探索的作用。具体而言，算法的每一轮得到的标签预测值<span class="math inline">\(y^{\prime}_t\)</span>根据一个概率分布向量<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{p}_t^{\prime}\)</span>采样产生：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[y^{\prime}_t\sim \boldsymbol{p}^{\prime}_t
\]</div><p></p><p>而概率分布向量<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{p}^{\prime}_t\)</span>经由一个单位向量<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{e}_{y^*_t}\)</span>（表示预测分布，<span class="math inline">\(y^*_t\)</span>索引元素为1而其余为0）和一个全1向量（表示随机分布）的插值产生：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\boldsymbol{p}_t^{\prime} = (1 - \max\left\{a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t), \gamma\right\})\boldsymbol{e}_{y^*_t} + \max\left\{a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t), \gamma\right\}\frac{1}{K}\boldsymbol{1}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中插值权重<span class="math inline">\(\max\left\{a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t), \gamma\right\}\)</span>经由<strong>差距映射（gap map）</strong><span class="math inline">\(a: \mathbb{R}^{K\times d}\times \mathbb{R}^d\rightarrow [0, 1]\)</span>的计算产生，根据选用的代理损失函数不同该映射函数也可能不同。参数<span class="math inline">\(\gamma\in [0, 1]\)</span>。在完全信息设置下，<span class="math inline">\(\gamma\)</span>被设置为0；但在bandit设置下<span class="math inline">\(\gamma\)</span>被用于保证每个标签被以至少<span class="math inline">\(\frac{\gamma}{K}\)</span>的概率采到，这是一个在bandit算法中的常见策略<sup>[8]</sup>。在这里每个标签被以至少<span class="math inline">\(\frac{\gamma}{K}\)</span>的概率采到是重要的，因为在bandit设置下，论文使用重要性加权（importance weighting）策略来得到代理损失<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t\)</span>的估计形式以及其对应的梯度<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{g}_t = \nabla\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>，因此需要控制这些估计的方差。在完全信息的设置下，设<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 0, \gamma = 0\)</span>，并将<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t\)</span>选择为hinge损失，则将得到与经典的<strong>感知机（perception）</strong> 算法相似的形式，而此算法可以被解释为在hinge损失上的OGD。</p>
<p>简记<span class="math inline">\(a_t = a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t)\)</span>。这里<span class="math inline">\(a_t\)</span>的作用为利用代理损失和0-1损失之间的差距，这个我们在后面介绍其具体形式的时候会进一步阐述。让我们回到之前所提到的<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{M}\)</span>的具体形式，可以继续用<span class="math inline">\(a_t\)</span>和<span class="math inline">\(\gamma\)</span>将其展开表示：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \begin{aligned}
        \mathcal{M} &amp;= \mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]\\
        &amp;= \mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{E}_t\left[\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t\neq y_t]\right] - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right] (\mathbb{E}_t[\cdot]\text{表示给定}t\text{时给定}(y_i^{\prime})_{i\leqslant t-1}\text{的条件期望})\\
        &amp;= \mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\left(1 - \max\{a_t, \gamma\}\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + \max\{a_t, \gamma\}\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]\\
        &amp;= \gamma\frac{K - 1}{K}T + \sum_{t=1}^T\underbrace{\mathbb{E}\left[\left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]}_{\text{surrogate gap}}\\
    \end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中最后一个不等式使用了<span class="math inline">\((1 - \max\{a_t, \gamma\})\leqslant (1 - a_t)\)</span>与<span class="math inline">\(\max\{a_t, \gamma\} = a_t + \gamma\)</span>。括号括起来的项称为<strong>代理差距（surrogate gap）</strong>。在完全信息的设置下，设<span class="math inline">\(\gamma = 0\)</span>，则此时若能证明代理差距（在可以调节差距映射<span class="math inline">\(a_t\)</span>的情况下）能被0界定，则就能证明常数的regret界。下图形象地展示了在<span class="math inline">\(K = 2, \gamma = 0，\eta = \frac{1}{8}\)</span>的设置下，通过条件<span class="math inline">\(a_t\)</span>使得代理差距<span class="math inline">\(\leqslant 0\)</span>的效果：</p>
<center>
<img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/cnblogs_com/blogs/538207/galleries/2445565/o_260716043547_surrogate_gap.png" width="600px" height="270px">
</center>
<p>设图中绿色的实线表示关于间隔<span class="math inline">\(z\)</span>的光滑hinge损失<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) = \max\left\{(1 - z)^2, 0\right\}\)</span>（这里<span class="math inline">\(z\)</span>为间隔），黑色实线表示关于间隔<span class="math inline">\(z\)</span>的0-1损失<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{I}[z\leqslant 0]\)</span>。首先，可以看到光滑hinge损失做为0-1损失的上界是可以将其界定的。然后我们进一步分析其它部分：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>红色实线表示<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}, \boldsymbol{x}) = 0\)</span>时，0-1损失加上了梯度项的<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{I}[z\leqslant 0] + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\)</span>，其中设当<span class="math inline">\(z\)</span> &gt; 0时<span class="math inline">\(\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2 = 4(1 - z)^2\)</span>否则<span class="math inline">\(\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2 = 4\)</span>。可以看到，红色实线有部分是在黄线上方的，这也就意味着<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{I}[z\leqslant 0] + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\)</span>减去光滑hinge损失<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>并不一定<span class="math inline">\(\leqslant 0\)</span>，也就意味着光滑hinge损失并不能完全将其抵消掉。此时的代理差距（体现为图中的红色实线值减去绿色实线值）并不一定<span class="math inline">\(\leqslant 0\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>蓝色实线表示<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}, \boldsymbol{x}) = (1 - |z|)^2\)</span>时的<span class="math inline">\(\left(1 - (1 - |z|)^2\right)\mathbb{I}[z\leqslant 0] + \frac{1}{2}(1 - |z|)^2 + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\)</span>，可以看到蓝色实线不会到黄线上方去，这也就意味着此时光滑hinge损失可以完全将其抵消掉。此时的代理差距（体现为图中的蓝色实线值减去绿色实线值）满足<span class="math inline">\(\leqslant 0\)</span>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>我们还可以发现，当<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}, \boldsymbol{x}) = 0\)</span>，减小学习率<span class="math inline">\(\eta\)</span>会扩大代理差距被0所界定的范围，但只有当<span class="math inline">\(\eta = 0\)</span>时代理差距才会处处被0所界定。但如果<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}, \boldsymbol{x}) = (1 - |z|)^2\)</span>，则代理差距对所有<span class="math inline">\(z\)</span>都可以被0所界定了。而对于完全信息的情况这将导致常数阶的regret界。</p>
<h1 id="4-采用不同代理损失时的代理差距">4 采用不同代理损失时的代理差距</h1>
<p>下面我们以完全信息的设置为例，分别在logistic损失和hinge损失的情况下去证明代理差距可以被0界定（并推导相应的差距映射<span class="math inline">\(a_t\)</span>）。由于是完全信息，在本部分设置<span class="math inline">\(\gamma = 0\)</span>。我们先来看logistic损失。</p>
<h2 id="41-logistic损失">4.1 logistic损失</h2>
<p>logistic损失可定义如下：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}) = -\log_2\left(\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}, \boldsymbol{x}_t, y_t)\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>其中<span class="math inline">\(\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}, x, k) = \frac{\exp\left(\langle\boldsymbol{w}_k, \boldsymbol{x}\rangle\right)}{\sum_{k^{\prime}=1}^K\exp\left(\langle \boldsymbol{w}_{k^{\prime}}, \boldsymbol{x}\rangle\right)}\)</span>是softmax函数（<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{w}_k\)</span>为<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{W}\)</span>第<span class="math inline">\(k\)</span>行的向量）。注意这里logistic函数是以2为底的，我的推测是这是应后面关于代理差距的证明的需要而设置的。对于logistic损失，论文使用下列的差距映射：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 1 - \mathbb{I}\left[p^*_t\geqslant 0.5\right]p^*_t
\]</div><p></p><p>其中<span class="math inline">\(p^*_t = \max_k\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t, k)\)</span>。这意味着GAPTRON会在<span class="math inline">\(p^*_t\leqslant 0.5\)</span>时均匀随机采样一个标签。下列事实在初看时可能是反直觉的：当<span class="math inline">\(p^*_t &lt; 0.5\)</span>时不管学习器预测标签是什么0-1损失都能够被logistic损失给界定，这是由于当<span class="math inline">\(p\in [0, 0.5]\)</span>时<span class="math inline">\(-\log_2(p)\geqslant 1\)</span>。而这一事实可以被用来证明当<span class="math inline">\(p^*_t &lt; 0.5\)</span>代理差距可以被0界定。</p>
<p>下面，我们展示在采用logistic损失并设<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 1 - \mathbb{I}[p^*_t\geqslant 0.5]p^*_t\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\eta = \frac{\ln(2)}{2KX^2}\)</span>的情况下，代理差距</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{surrogate gap} = \mathbb{E}\left[\left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]
\]</div><p></p><p>可以被0界定。</p>
<p>我们先求<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>关于<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{W}_t\)</span>的梯度<span class="math inline">\(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t} \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>。由于函数关于矩阵求导等价于关于矩阵的每一个元素求导<sup>[9]</sup>，因此<span class="math inline">\(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t} \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>也是一个和<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{W}_t\)</span>行数和列数相同的<span class="math inline">\(K\times d\)</span>矩阵，其每个元素为<span class="math inline">\(\left[\nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t} \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\right]_{ij} = \frac{\partial \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)}{\partial w_{ij}}\)</span>。当然逐元素求导可能过于繁杂，我们这里将<span class="math inline">\(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t} \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>视为行向量拼成的矩阵，其中每个行向量是梯度向量<span class="math inline">\(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_t}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t} \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) =
    \left(
        \begin{aligned}
            &amp;\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_1}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\\
            &amp;\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_2}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\\
            &amp;\quad\quad\space \vdots\\
            &amp;\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_K}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\\
        \end{aligned}
    \right)
\]</div><p></p><p>于是，我们接着表示<span class="math inline">\(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_k}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_k}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) &amp;= \nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_k}\left(-\log_2\left(\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t, y_t)\right)\right)\\
&amp;= \frac{1}{\ln 2}\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_k}\left(\log\left(\sum_{k^{\prime}=1}^K\exp\left(\langle \boldsymbol{w}_{t,k^{\prime}}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle\right)\right) - \langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t,y_t}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle\right)\\
&amp;= \frac{1}{\ln 2}\left(\frac{\exp\left(\langle \boldsymbol{w}_{t, k}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle\right)\boldsymbol{x}_t}{\sum_{k^{\prime}=1}^K\exp\left(\langle \boldsymbol{w}_{t, k^{\prime}}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle\right)} - \mathbb{I}[y_t = k]\boldsymbol{x}_t\right)\\
&amp;= \frac{1}{\ln2}\left(\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t, k) - \mathbb{I}[y_t = k]\right)\boldsymbol{x}_t
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>因此，有</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) = \frac{1}{\ln 2}\left(\tilde{\boldsymbol{p}}_t - \boldsymbol{e}_{y_t}\right)\otimes \boldsymbol{x}_t
\]</div><p></p><p>其中<span class="math inline">\(\tilde{\boldsymbol{p}}_t = (\tilde{p}_t(1), \cdots, \tilde{p}_t(k))^{\top}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\tilde{p}_t(k) = \sigma(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t, k)\)</span>。式中的<span class="math inline">\(\otimes\)</span>为矩阵的Kronecker积<sup>[10]</sup>，这里可以理解为将向量<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{x}_t\)</span>乘以<span class="math inline">\(\tilde{\boldsymbol{p}}_t - \boldsymbol{e}_{y_t}\)</span>的每一个标量元素，然后将所得的结果拼成一个新矩阵。</p>
<p>接着，我们证明<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W})\)</span>满足一个重要的性质：它是 <strong>自界（self-bounded）</strong><sup>[7]</sup>的，也即意味着该函数的梯度的范数平方可以被函数自身乘一个常数给界定：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\lVert \nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t} \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\rVert^2\leqslant \frac{2}{\ln 2}X^2\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)
\]</div><p></p><p>证明如下：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
    &amp;\lVert \nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t} \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\rVert^2 \\
    &amp;= \frac{1}{\left(\ln 2\right)^2}\lVert\boldsymbol{x}_t\rVert^2\left(\sum_{k=1}^K\left(\mathbb{I}[y_t = k] - \tilde{p}_t(k)\right)^2\right)\\
    &amp;\leqslant \frac{1}{\left(\ln 2\right)^2}\lVert\boldsymbol{x}_t\rVert^2\left(\sum_{k=1}^K\lvert\mathbb{I}[y_t = k] - \tilde{p}_t(k)\rvert\right)^2
    \left(a_1^2 + \cdots +a_n^2\leqslant \left(|a_1| + \cdots + |a_n|\right)^2\right)\\
    &amp;\leqslant -\frac{2}{\ln 2}\lVert\boldsymbol{x}_t\rVert^2\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right)\quad (\text{Pinsker不等式[11]})\\
    &amp;\leqslant -\frac{2}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right)\quad (\lVert\boldsymbol{x}_t\rVert^2\leqslant X)\\
    &amp;= \frac{2}{\ln 2}X^2\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p><strong>Pinsker不等式<sup>[11]</sup></strong>：对任意两个在样本空间<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{H}\)</span>上定义的概率分布<span class="math inline">\(P_1\)</span> 和<span class="math inline">\(P_2\)</span>，设<span class="math inline">\(D(P_1\Vert P_2)\)</span>为它们之间的KL散度，<span class="math inline">\(\lVert P_1 - P_2 \rVert_1 = \sum_{a\in \mathcal{H}}\lvert P_1(a) - P_2(a)\rvert\)</span>为它们之间的<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{L}_1\)</span>距离，则有下列不等式成立：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[D(P_1 \Vert P_2)\geqslant \frac{1}{2\ln 2}\lVert P_1 - P_2\rVert^2_1 
\]</div><p></p><p>（在上述的证明中将单位向量<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{e}_{y_t}\)</span>所对应的分布（概率在<span class="math inline">\(y_t\)</span>处为1其余处为0）做为<span class="math inline">\(P_1\)</span>，将<span class="math inline">\(\tilde{\boldsymbol{p}}_t\)</span>所对应的分布做为<span class="math inline">\(P_2\)</span>即可。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>有了这个性质，可以进一步将代理差距界定如下（这里注意<span class="math inline">\(a_t = a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 1 - \mathbb{I}[p^*_t\geqslant 0.5]p^*_t\)</span>，其中<span class="math inline">\(p^*_t = \max_k\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t, k)\)</span>）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
&amp; \text{surrogate gap} \\
&amp;= \mathbb{E}\left[\left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]\\
&amp;= \left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\quad (\text{完全信息设置下}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)和\boldsymbol{g}_t不涉及随机选择)\\
&amp;\leqslant \left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\\
&amp;= \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
        &amp; 0 + \frac{K - 1}{K} + \log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) &amp;\text{if } p^*_t &lt; 0.5 \\
        &amp; p^*_t + (1 - p^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} + \log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) &amp;\text{if } y^*_t\neq y_t \text{ and }p^*_t\geqslant 0.5 \\
        &amp;(1 - p^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} + \log_2(p_t^*) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(p_t^*) &amp;\text{if } y^*_t = y_t \text{ and }p^*_t\geqslant 0.5 \\
    \end{aligned}
\right.
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>接着进行分类讨论。</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\((1)\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(p_t^* &lt; 0.5\)</span>：</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
    &amp;\frac{K - 1}{K} + \log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) \\
    &amp;\leqslant -\frac{K - 1}{K}\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) + \log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right)\quad \left(1\leqslant -\log_2(x)\right) \\
    &amp;= \frac{1}{K}\log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)) \\
    &amp;\leqslant 0 \quad \left(\eta = \frac{\ln(2)}{2KX^2} &lt; \frac{\ln 2}{KX^2}\right) 
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\((2)\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(y^*_t\neq y_t\)</span>且<span class="math inline">\(p^*_t\geqslant 0.5\)</span>：</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
    &amp;p^*_t + (1 - p^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} + \log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)) \\
    &amp;\leqslant -\frac{1}{2}\log_2(1 - p^*_t) - \frac{K - 1}{2K}\log_2(1 - p^*_t) + \log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t))\\
    &amp;\left(x\leqslant -\frac{1}{2}\log_2(1 - x) \text{ for } x\in [0.5, 1], 1 - x\leqslant -\frac{1}{2}\log_2(1 - x) \text{ for } x\in [0.5, 1]\right) \\
    &amp;= -\frac{1}{2}\log_2\left(\sum_{k\neq y^*_t}^K \tilde{p}_t(k)\right) - \frac{K - 1}{2K}\log_2\left(\sum_{k\neq y^*_t}^K \tilde{p}_t(k)\right) + \log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t))\\
    &amp;\leqslant -\frac{1}{2}\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) - \frac{K - 1}{2K}\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) + \log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t))\\
    &amp;= \frac{1}{2K}\log_2\left(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)\right) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(\tilde{p}_t(y_t)) \\
    &amp;= 0 \quad \left(\eta = \frac{\ln(2)}{2KX^2}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\((3)\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(y^*_t = y_t\)</span>且<span class="math inline">\(p^*_t\geqslant 0.5\)</span>：</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
    &amp;(1 - p^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} + \log_2(p_t^*) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(p_t^*) \\
    &amp;\leqslant -\frac{K - 1}{K}\log_2(p_t^*) + \log_2(p_t^*) - \frac{\eta}{\ln 2}X^2\log_2(p_t^*)\\
    &amp;\left(1 - x\leqslant -\log_2(x)\right) \\
    &amp;\leqslant 0 \quad \left(\eta = \frac{\ln(2)}{2KX^2}  &lt; \frac{\ln 2}{KX^2}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>因此，在采用logistic损失并设<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 1 - \mathbb{I}[p^*_t\geqslant 0.5]p^*_t\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\eta = \frac{\ln(2)}{2KX^2}\)</span>的情况下，代理差距 <span class="math inline">\(\text{surrogate gap}\leqslant 0\)</span><br>
得证。</p>
<p>于是有</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \begin{aligned}
        \mathcal{R}_T &amp;\leqslant \frac{\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{2\eta} + \gamma\frac{K - 1}{K}T + \sum_{t=1}^T\underbrace{\mathbb{E}\left[\left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]}_{\text{surrogate gap}\leqslant 0}\\
        &amp;\leqslant \frac{\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{2\eta}\quad (\text{设置} \gamma = 0)\\
        &amp;= \frac{KX^2\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{\ln 2}
    \end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>常数阶regret界得证。</p>
<h2 id="42-多类别hinge损失">4.2 多类别hinge损失</h2>
<p>接着，我们来看多类别hinge损失的情况。本文使用了Crammer-Singer多分类hinge损失<sup>[12]</sup>的变体，其定义如下：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}) = \left\{\begin{aligned}
       &amp;\max\left\{1 - m_t(\boldsymbol{W}, y_t), 0\right\}\quad &amp;\text{if } m^*_t\leqslant \beta\\
       &amp;\max\left\{1 - m_t(\boldsymbol{W}, y_t), 0\right\}\quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t\neq y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta\\
       &amp;0\quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t = y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta
    \end{aligned}\right.
\]</div><p></p><p>设这里<span class="math inline">\(\beta\)</span>的取值范围为<span class="math inline">\([0, 1)\)</span>。对于多类别hinge损失，论文使用下列差距映射：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 1 - \max\left\{\mathbb{I}[m^*_t &gt; \beta], m^*_t\right\}
\]</div><p></p><p>多类别hinge损失的定义式中，间隔<span class="math inline">\(m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y) = \langle \boldsymbol{w}_{t, y}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle - \max_{k\neq y}\langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t, k}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle\)</span>，最大间隔<span class="math inline">\(m^*_t = \max_k m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, k)\)</span>。注意这里当<span class="math inline">\(y^*_t = y_t\)</span>且<span class="math inline">\(m^*_t &gt; \beta\)</span>时设置<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}) = 0\)</span>，而在感知机的一般实现中只要<span class="math inline">\(y^*_t = y_t\)</span>就有<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}) = 0\)</span><sup>[13]</sup>。这里之所以要设置参数<span class="math inline">\(\beta\)</span>的原因是代理差距</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{surrogate gap} = \mathbb{E}\left[\left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]
\]</div><p></p><p>中有项<span class="math inline">\(a_t\frac{K - 1}{K}\)</span>，而对于这项只要<span class="math inline">\(m^*_t \leqslant \beta\)</span>它就不为0。而当<span class="math inline">\(y_t^* = y_t\)</span>且<span class="math inline">\(m^*_t \leqslant \beta\)</span>时，如果<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) = 0\)</span>，那么将没有项能够去抵消掉<span class="math inline">\(a_t\frac{K - 1}{K}\)</span>（注意此时<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] = \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) = \lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2 = 0\)</span>）。观察<span class="math inline">\(a_t\)</span>的表达式还可以发现，如果<span class="math inline">\(m^*_t &gt; \beta\)</span>则<span class="math inline">\(a_t = 0\)</span>，此时GAPTRON的预测等价于感知机的预测。</p>
<p>下面，我们展示在采用多类别hinge损失并设<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 1 - \max\left\{\mathbb{I}[m^*_t &gt; \beta], m^*_t\right\}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\eta = \frac{1 - \beta}{KX^2}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\beta = \frac{1}{K}\)</span>的情况下，代理差距</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{surrogate gap} = \mathbb{E}\left[\left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]
\]</div><p></p><p>可以被0界定。</p>
<p>我们先求<span class="math inline">\(\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>关于<span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{W}_t\)</span>的梯度<span class="math inline">\(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t} \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>。和之前类似， 我们先表示<span class="math inline">\(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_k}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t)\)</span>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_k}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) &amp;= 
\left\{\begin{aligned}
       &amp;\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_k}\max\left\{1 - m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t), 0\right\}\quad &amp;\text{if } m^*_t\leqslant \beta\\
       &amp;\nabla_{\boldsymbol{w}_k}\max\left\{1 - m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t), 0\right\}\quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t\neq y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta\\
       &amp;0\quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t = y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta
    \end{aligned}\right.\\
&amp;= 
\left\{\begin{aligned}
       &amp;\left(\mathbb{I}[\mathrm{arg \space max}_{k^{\prime}\neq y_t}\langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t, k^{\prime}}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle = k] - \mathbb{I}[y_t = k]\right)\boldsymbol{x}_t \quad &amp;\text{if } m^*_t\leqslant \beta\\
       &amp;\left(\mathbb{I}[\mathrm{arg \space max}_{k^{\prime}\neq y_t}\langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t, k^{\prime}}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle = k] - \mathbb{I}[y_t = k]\right)\boldsymbol{x}_t\quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t\neq y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta\\
       &amp;0\quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t = y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta
    \end{aligned}\right.\\
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>因此，有</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla_{\boldsymbol{W}_t}\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) = 
\left\{\begin{aligned}
       &amp;\left(\boldsymbol{e}_{\tilde{k}} - \boldsymbol{e}_{y_t}\right)\otimes\boldsymbol{x}_t \quad &amp;\text{if } m^*_t\leqslant \beta\\
       &amp;\left(\boldsymbol{e}_{\tilde{k}} - \boldsymbol{e}_{y_t}\right)\otimes \boldsymbol{x}_t\quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t\neq y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta\\
       &amp;0\quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t = y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta
    \end{aligned}\right.
\]</div><p></p><p>其中<span class="math inline">\(\tilde{k} = \mathrm{arg \space max}_{k\neq y_t}\langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t, k}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle\)</span>。</p>
<p>有了这个性质，可以进一步将代理差距界定如下（这里注意<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 1 - \max\left\{\mathbb{I}[m^*_t &gt; \beta], m^*_t\right\}\)</span>，其中<span class="math inline">\(m^*_t = \max_k m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, k)\)</span>）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
&amp; \text{surrogate gap} \\
&amp;= \left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\quad\\
&amp;\leqslant \left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \eta X^2\\
&amp;= \left\{\begin{aligned}
       &amp;m^*_t + (1 - m^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} - \left(1 - m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t)\right) + \eta X^2 \quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t\neq y_t \text{ and } m^*_t\leqslant \beta\\
       &amp;(1 - m^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} - (1 - m^*_t) + \eta X^2 \quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t = y_t \text{ and } m^*_t \leqslant \beta\\
       &amp;1 - (1 - m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t)) + \eta X^2 \quad &amp;\text{if } y^*_t \neq y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta\\
       &amp;0 &amp;\text{if } y^*_t = y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta\\
    \end{aligned}\right.
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>在接下来的证明之前先证明一个有用的结论。对<span class="math inline">\(y_t\neq y^*\)</span>，有</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
&amp;m^*_t + m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t)\\
&amp;= \langle \boldsymbol{w}_{t, y^*_t}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle - \max_{k\neq y^*_t}\langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t,k}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle + \langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t, y_t}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle - \max_{k\neq y_t}\langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t,k}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle\\
&amp;= \langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t, y_t}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle - \max_{k\neq y^*_t}\langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t,k}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle\\
&amp;\leqslant \langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t, y_t}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle - \langle\boldsymbol{w}_{t,k}, \boldsymbol{x}_t\rangle = 0
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>接着进行分类讨论（<span class="math inline">\(y^*_t = y_t \text{ and } m^*_t &gt; \beta\)</span>时已有<span class="math inline">\(\text{surrogate gap} = 0\)</span>，故不再单列）。</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\((1)\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(y^*_t\neq y_t\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(m^*_t\leqslant \beta\)</span>：</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
    &amp;m^*_t + (1 - m^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} - \left(1 - m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t)\right) + \eta X^2 \\
    &amp;= \underbrace{m^*_t + m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t)}_{\leqslant 0}\ + (1 - m^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} - 1 + \eta X^2 \\
    &amp;= -\frac{1}{K} + \eta X^2  \\
    &amp;\leqslant 0 \quad \left(\eta = \frac{1 - \beta}{KX^2} &lt; \frac{1}{KX^2}\right) 
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\((2)\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(y^*_t = y_t\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(m^*_t \leqslant \beta\)</span>：</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
    &amp;(1 - m^*_t)\frac{K - 1}{K} - (1 - m^*_t) + \eta X^2 \\
    &amp;= -\frac{1}{K}(1 - m^*_t) + \eta X^2\\
    &amp;\leqslant -\frac{(1 - \beta)}{K} + \eta X^2\\
    &amp;= 0 \quad \left(\eta = \frac{1 - \beta}{KX^2}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\((3)\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(y^*_t \neq y_t\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(m^*_t &gt; \beta\)</span>：</li>
</ul>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
    &amp;1 - (1 - m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t)) + \eta X^2  \\
    &amp;= m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t) + \eta X^2 \\
    &amp;\leqslant -m^*_t + \eta X^2\quad \left(m^*_t + m_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t, y_t)\leqslant 0\right)\\
    &amp;\leqslant -\beta + \eta X^2\\
    &amp;\leqslant 0 \quad \left(\eta = \frac{1 - \beta}{KX^2}  \leqslant \frac{\beta}{KX^2} \text{ for } \beta = \frac{1}{K}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>因此，在采用多类别hinge损失并设<span class="math inline">\(a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t) = 1 - \max\left\{\mathbb{I}[m^*_t &gt; \beta], m^*_t\right\}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\eta = \frac{1 - \beta}{KX^2}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\beta = \frac{1}{K}\)</span>的情况下，代理差距</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{surrogate gap} = \mathbb{E}\left[\left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]
\]</div><p></p><p>可以被0界定。</p>
<p>于是有</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[    \begin{aligned}
        \mathcal{R}_T &amp;\leqslant \frac{\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{2\eta} + \gamma\frac{K - 1}{K}T + \sum_{t=1}^T\underbrace{\mathbb{E}\left[\left(1 - a_t\right)\mathbb{I}[y^*_t\neq y_t] + a_t\frac{K - 1}{K} - \ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}_t) + \frac{\eta}{2}\lVert\boldsymbol{g}_t\rVert^2\right]}_{\text{surrogate gap}\leqslant 0}\\
        &amp;\leqslant \frac{\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{2\eta}\quad (\text{设置} \gamma = 0)\\
        &amp;= \frac{K^2X^2\lVert\boldsymbol{U}\rVert^2}{2(K - 1)}
    \end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>常数阶regret界得证。</p>
<p>除了logistic损失和多类别hinge损失之外，论文还讨论了光滑多类别hinge损失（smooth multiclass hinge loss）的代理差距。感兴趣的读者可以去阅读原论文。</p>
<h1 id="5-bandit设置">5 bandit设置</h1>
<p>论文还讨论了bandit设置下的代理差距，这里我们简要介绍一下logistic损失的bandit版本的形式。logistic的bandit版本定义如下：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W}) = -\frac{\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t = y_t]}{p^{\prime}_t(y^{\prime}_t)}\log_2\left(\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}, \boldsymbol{x}_t, y_t)\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>（如之前所定义的，<span class="math inline">\(
\boldsymbol{p}_t^{\prime} = (1 - \max\left\{a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t), \gamma\right\})\boldsymbol{e}_{y^*_t} + \max\left\{a(\boldsymbol{W}_t, \boldsymbol{x}_t), \gamma\right\}\frac{1}{K}\boldsymbol{1}
\)</span>）</p>
<p>这里除以<span class="math inline">\(p^{\prime}_t(y^{\prime}_t)\)</span>的一个相关技术被称为<strong>重要性采样（importance sampling）</strong><sup>[14]</sup>，该技术在bandit设置中应用广泛<sup>[15]</sup>，可以使得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
    &amp;\mathbb{E}_t[\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W})]\\
    &amp;= \sum_{y_t^{\prime}\in \mathcal{Y}}-\frac{\mathbb{I}[y^{\prime}_t = y_t]}{p^{\prime}_t(y^{\prime}_t)}\log_2\left(\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}, \boldsymbol{x}_t, y_t)\right)p^{\prime}_t(y^{\prime}_t)\\
    &amp;= -\log_2\left(\sigma(\boldsymbol{W}, \boldsymbol{x}_t, y_t)\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>也即使得<span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{E}_t[\ell_t(\boldsymbol{W})]\)</span>与其完全信息设置下的对应版本相等。</p>
